# `api.jobs.handling_units.replace_materials`

> `PUT /job/{jobDisplayId}/handlingUnit/{id}/materials` — ACPortal

**Python**

```python
api.jobs.handling_units.replace_materials(job_display_id: int, handling_unit_id: int, *, data: list[HandlingUnitMaterialModel]) -> list[HandlingUnitMaterial]
```

**CLI**

```bash
ab jobs handling_units replace_materials <job_display_id> <handling_unit_id> [--data ...]
```

``PUT /job/{jobDisplayId}/handlingUnit/{id}/materials`` — replaces the complete material list.

## Request body — `List[HandlingUnitMaterialModel]`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `materialId` | `int` | no | Company material definition ID. |
| `quantityPlanned` | `float` | no | Planned material quantity. |
| `unitCost` | `float` | no | Cost per material unit. |
| `addedByAutoPacker` | `bool` | no | Whether automatic packing added this material. |
| `wasteQuantity` | `float` | no | Material quantity consumed as waste. |
